prompt: Locked eye-level camera orbiting slowly around a young man seen from behind on a pixel-art Haitian coastal beach. Two smooth legs with no cut. Flat two-tone gray and white sea. Same hair, skin and clothing throughout. Strict palette: black, bone white, graphite gray, coral, blue. Hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no white outline around the figure, no horizontal wave streaks or bars, no text, no camera shake, no cuts.
